testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect the context menu for an Origin axis: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-workspace-layout-source/features/application/workspace-layout/workspace-layout.feature:545:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect the context menu for an Origin axis ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software with a visible solid ✔ And the Origin branch is expanded in the model browser ✔ And Auto-Resize is enabled for the Y Axis in the captured session ✔ When the user right-clicks the Y Axis row ✔ Then a context menu opens beside the axis row ✔ And the menu offers Copy, Measure, Visibility and Auto-Resize ✔ And Auto-Resize is checked in this session ✔ And the axis row is highlighted ✔ And the corresponding axis is highlighted in the viewport ✔ When the user clicks an empty area of the viewport outside the menu ✔ Then the context menu closes ✔ And the axis row and axis remain highlighted ✔ When the user clicks the empty viewport area again ✔ Then the axis is no longer highlighted in the viewport ✔ And the axis row no longer has the filled selection highlight ✔ And the axis row retains a focus outline ✔ And the solid remains visible
